name: Unused-Region Expansion
description: AWS accounts can use many regions. Attackers like quiet ones: no GuardDuty, thin CloudTrail, nobody watching the bill. They enable a region or simply start creating resources where you never operate. From there they mine, exfiltrate, or persist far from your usual dashboards. Region opt-in and first-time resource creation in unused regions should page the cloud team.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
